helpText: CODEATLAS HELPa reading surface over an indexed repository[esc] closeWhat this isCodeAtlasWeb reads a repository that the analysis server has indexed and explains it: the tree and the source, a twin of the symbol under the caret, a walk along the calls, the scope of a change, and the answers of a local model.Everything on this screen comes from that index or from a file the server handed over, and every panel says which of the two it is.What it cannot doThe reader is read-only: you cannot edit a file here, and what you type into it changes nothing.It cannot run code, and there is no terminal: no build, no test run, no shell, no process started from this window.It reaches no cloud. The only model it can use is a sidecar on this machine, started by hand, and it stays off until it answers.That is the shape of the product and not a missing release: this surface has no backend of its own, and the analysis server offers a read-only surface.
